venue: The Ranch, with two Sunday finals events at the Morgan Hill Aquatics Center and Morgan Hill Sports Complex (Stage 1 contested online)
dates: September 18-19, 2020 (Stage 1, online) and October 23-25, 2020 (Finals at The Ranch)
formatNotes: COVID-19 forced a two-stage Games with no team, masters, or teen divisions. Stage 1 (Sept 18-19): 30 men and 30 women competed remotely from their own gyms in 7 events, performed on camera with remote judging and a live broadcast. The top 5 per division advanced. Stage 2 finals (Oct 23-25): 5 men and 5 women competed in person at The Ranch in Aromas, California (site of the first Games in 2007) across 12 events, broadcast live on CBS Sports; two Sunday events (Swim 'N' Stuff, Sprint Sled Sprint) were contested at the Morgan Hill Aquatics Center and Morgan Hill Sports Complex. Scores RESET between stages. Finals scoring per event: 100-75-55-35-15 points for 1st-5th, with a 'full effort' rule allowing judges to award 0 points to an athlete deemed not to be giving full effort. Most Stage 1 events had no time cap.
yearSummary: The pandemic year split the Games into an online Stage 1 for 30 athletes per division and an in-person final for the top 5 at The Ranch in Aromas, returning the sport to its 2007 birthplace. Programming leaned on benchmark riffs (Friendly Fran, Damn Diane, Nasty Nancy, Awful Annie) in Stage 1, then turned rugged at the ranch: a surprise 6-mile out-and-back trail run, a corn sack hill sprint, the CrossFit Total, and the vest chipper Atalanta to close. Mat Fraser won 14 of his 19 events, took the finals by a record 545 points, and claimed a record fifth straight title before retiring; Tia-Clair Toomey won 13 events and her fourth straight title by a women's-record 360-point margin. Justin Medeiros announced himself as Fraser's heir with a rookie podium run, and Kari Pearce closed her career by beating the entire field, men included, on Atalanta.

events.name: Friendly Fran
events.description:
3 rounds for time of:
21 thrusters
21 chest-to-bar pull-ups

Men: 115-lb barbell
Women: 85-lb barbell

Athletes begin behind a start line, complete all 3 rounds, and finish by crossing the start/finish line. Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: A heavier, higher-volume riff on the benchmark Fran (21-15-9 at 95/65 with regular pull-ups). Fraser won by 47 seconds over Noah Ohlsen (3:55).

events.name: 1-Rep-Max Front Squat
events.description:
Establish a 1-rep-max front squat.

Athletes had up to 3 attempts, taken within a 20-minute broadcast window with roughly 3 minutes between attempts. Score is the heaviest successful lift. Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: Games rookie Griffin Roelle shocked the field with a 490-lb front squat; Fraser finished 4th. Toomey's 313 lb led the women ahead of Laura Clifton (302 lb).

events.name: Damn Diane
events.description:
3 rounds for time of:
15 deadlifts
15 strict deficit handstand push-ups

Men: 315-lb deadlift, 3.5-inch deficit
Women: 205-lb deadlift, 2-inch deficit

Begins with the barbell on the floor; athletes complete all 3 rounds and cross the finish line. Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: A heavier, stricter riff on the benchmark Diane (21-15-9 deadlifts at 225/155 and kipping handstand push-ups). Toomey's win here made her the first athlete ever to win the opening three events of a Games.

events.name: 1,000-m Row
events.description:
For time:
Row 1,000 meters

Athlete starts seated on the rower; score is total time to complete the distance. Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: Khrennikov, competing remotely from Russia, took the men's event; Slovakia's Karin Freyová won the women's over Amanda Barnhart (3:17.40).

events.name: Nasty Nancy
events.description:
5 rounds for time of:
500-m run
15 overhead squats
15 bar-facing burpees

Men: 185-lb barbell
Women: 125-lb barbell

Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: A loaded, longer riff on the benchmark Nancy (5 rounds of 400-m run and 15 overhead squats at 95/65) with bar-facing burpees added. Davidsdottir edged Kristin Holte (18:23) for the women's win; Toomey was 3rd.

events.name: Handstand Hold
events.description:
For max time:
Longest freestanding handstand hold within a 20-minute window.

Athletes kick up inside a 4-by-4-foot box and may make unlimited attempts; an attempt ends when the hands cross the box border or the feet or head touch the ground. Score is the single longest hold. Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: First time a max-duration freestanding handstand hold was contested at the Games. Ohlsen beat Fraser by 2 seconds (1:37 to 1:35); Davidsdottir's 2:54 won the women's by 41 seconds.

events.name: Awful Annie
events.description:
For time:
50-40-30-20-10 reps of:
Double-unders (heavy rope)
GHD sit-ups
with 5-4-3-2-1 cleans after each couplet round

(50 double-unders, 50 GHD sit-ups, 5 cleans; 40-40-4; 30-30-3; 20-20-2; 10-10-1)

Men: 275-lb clean
Women: 185-lb clean

Double-unders performed with a heavy 'Drag' rope (Rx Smart Gear, roughly 10 oz, no swivel handles). Performed remotely at each athlete's own location.
events.notes: A loaded riff on the benchmark Annie. Kara Saunders was initially announced as the women's event winner, but the result was corrected to Toomey after a scoring review. The heavy Drag rope made its Games debut here. After this event the field was cut to the top 5 men and top 5 women, who advanced to the finals at The Ranch.

events.name: 2007 Reload
events.description:
For time:
1,500-meter row
Then, 5 rounds of:
10 bar muscle-ups
7 shoulder-to-overheads

Men: 235-lb barbell
Women: 145-lb barbell
events.notes: Opening event of the in-person finals, a beefed-up reload of the 2007 Games workout (1,000-m row then 5 rounds of 25 pull-ups and 7 push jerks at 135/85). Rookie Justin Medeiros finished 8 seconds behind Fraser (13:15.16).

events.name: Corn Sack Sprint
events.description:
For time:
320-meter hill sprint carrying a corn sack

Men: 50-lb sack
Women: 30-lb sack

Athletes sprint up the steep ranch hillside carrying the sack any way they choose.
events.notes: A nod to the hill sprints of the early Aromas Games, with a corn sack standing in for the area's farm heritage.

events.name: CrossFit Total
events.description:
For total load:
1-rep-max back squat
1-rep-max shoulder press
1-rep-max deadlift

Athletes took turns lifting, with three attempts at each lift and roughly 3 minutes of rest between attempts. Score is the sum of the heaviest successful attempt at each lift.
events.notes: A throwback to the 2007 Games, which also featured the CrossFit Total at the same ranch. Jeffrey Adler beat Fraser here, one of only two events Fraser lost all weekend.

events.name: Handstand Sprint
events.description:
For time:
100-yard handstand walk

A straight 100-yard handstand-walk sprint across the ranch floor.
events.notes: Brooke Wells took the women's event, one of only three events Toomey lost. Wells's winning time was within half a second of Fraser's men's time.

events.name: Ranch Loop
events.description:
For time:
Run the ranch trail loop, approximately 3 miles of varying terrain, often steep and loose.

The twist: when athletes reached what they believed was the finish, Dave Castro told them to turn around and run the entire course again in reverse, making the event roughly 6 miles total with substantial elevation gain.
events.notes: One of the longest running events in Games history at about 6 miles. The surprise reverse loop was revealed only as athletes crossed the apparent finish. Fraser, historically weak on long runs, won the men's race with Medeiros alongside him most of the way. Davidsdottir won the women's by about 2 minutes over Haley Adams and 6 minutes over Toomey.

events.name: Toes-to-Bar/Lunge
events.description:
For time:
30-20-10 reps of:
Toes-to-bars
Kettlebell lunge (yards)

Men: two 32-kg kettlebells
Women: two 24-kg kettlebells

Kettlebells held in the front-rack position; the lunge is measured in yards (30, then 20, then 10).

events.name: Snatch Speed Triple
events.description:
Three-round elimination snatch ladder. In each round, athletes race down a line of 3 barbells, completing 1 snatch at each bar, ascending in load; the slowest athlete is eliminated. 2 minutes of rest between rounds.

Quarterfinal (5 athletes, 1-minute cap):
Men: 225-235-245 lb / Women: 145-150-155 lb

Semifinal (4 athletes, 2-minute cap):
Men: 245-255-265 lb / Women: 160-165-170 lb

Final (3 athletes, 3-minute cap):
Men: 265-275-285 lb / Women: 175-180-185 lb
events.notes: Placement-scored elimination event (round caps of 1, 2, and 3 minutes), echoing the 2015 Snatch Speed Ladder. Fraser missed his first attempt at the final 285-lb bar, recovered immediately, and won the final round in about 44 seconds.

events.name: Bike Repeater
events.description:
10 rounds for time of:
440-meter bike sprint
1 legless rope climb (15 ft)

Athletes sprint a bike down and back across the field, then complete a legless rope climb each round.
events.notes: Contested on mountain-style bikes over the ranch terrain. Jeffrey Adler finished just 1.6 seconds behind Fraser (12:56.35).

events.name: Happy Star
events.description:
4 rounds for time of:
200- to 300-meter hill run
5-7-9-11 reps of:
Burpee
Thruster

Round 1: 5 burpees, 5 thrusters (135 lb men / 95 lb women)
Round 2: 7 burpees, 7 thrusters (145 lb / 105 lb)
Round 3: 9 burpees, 9 thrusters (155 lb / 110 lb)
Round 4: 11 burpees, 11 thrusters (165 lb / 115 lb)

The run course changes each round, tracing the points of a star on the hillside, while reps and barbell loads increase.
events.notes: Named for the star-shaped pattern the four hill-run legs traced on the ranch hillside.

events.name: Swim 'N' Stuff
events.description:
4 rounds, each for time, beginning a new round every 4 minutes:
Air bike calories (15 men / 10 women)
50-meter swim
10 GHD sit-ups
10 ball slams
Rest until the next 4-minute interval

Men: 60-lb ball
Women: 40-lb ball

Rounds 2 and 4 are performed in reverse order (ball slams, GHD sit-ups, swim, bike). Score is the sum of the four round times. Contested at the Morgan Hill Aquatics Center in Morgan Hill, California, not at the Ranch.
events.notes: Held at the Morgan Hill Aquatics Center in Morgan Hill, CA, one of two Sunday events contested away from the Ranch. Samuel Kwant took the men's event over Fraser, the only event Fraser lost after Day 1 and his second and final loss of the weekend.

events.name: Sprint Sled Sprint
events.description:
For time:
100-yard sprint
100-yard sled push
100-yard sprint

Men: 105-lb sled
Women: 80-lb sled
events.notes: Contested on the field at the Morgan Hill Sports Complex in Morgan Hill, CA, one of two Sunday events held away from the Ranch. Fastest event of the finals; Fraser edged Kwant by less than a second.

events.name: Atalanta
events.description:
For time, wearing a weight vest:
1-mile run
100 handstand push-ups
200 single-leg squats
300 pull-ups
1-mile run

Men: 20-lb vest
Women: 14-lb vest

Reps are completed unpartitioned and in order; movements cannot be mixed.
events.notes: A super-sized, unpartitioned cousin of Murph that debuted as the final event. Kari Pearce's 47:56.68 was the fastest time of either division, nearly 4 minutes ahead of men's winner Fraser. The event sealed Fraser's record fifth straight title (largest finals margin in Games history, 545 points) and Toomey's fourth (women's record 360-point margin).
